_doc: [SONNET-4.6] sq-gg0qq.7 — the PINNED Solid-CTH floor for sparq-lws-core, enforced by conformance/run.sh after every run. Scores are GENERATED (EARL report -> reports/report.ttl), never committed as prose; this file holds only the ratchet bounds so a regression fails loudly instead of being re-narrated in markdown. Raise `min_passed` when a run beats it; NEVER lower it to go green. `expected_total` is the suite SIZE the TestSubject claims after its skip tags — a change there means the manifests or the skips moved and needs re-triage, not a floor edit.

source._doc: Where the floor came from. The upstream repo this crate was imported from (sq-gg0qq.2) recorded this suite as fully passing at the import commit; this port carries the same bound forward and run.sh re-derives the actual score from the EARL report on every run.
